title: Capture of the Rif (1792)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of the Rif (1792)", at revision 1370610053, opens: "The Capture of the Rif took place in 1792 and was orchestrated by the Bey of Oran, Mohammed el-Kebir, to capture the eastern Rif region in northern Morocco." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q107027848, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1792 conquest". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
